text:
alex: Heads-up — the diagram on the KB page 'Model onboarding prerequisites' is 404ing: https://kb.redwood.ai/model-onboarding/prereqs#arch-diagram
alex: I tried the S3 path `s3://kb-assets/diagrams/onboarding-arch.png` and it returns 403. Can someone who owns this doc take a look? :eyes:
docs-bot: Automated scan flagged asset `s3://kb-assets/diagrams/onboarding-arch.png` as returning 403. Created task #7621 for follow-up. :spiral_notepad:
maria: I own the model onboarding page — thanks for the ping. I'll patch it. Can we rehost to `https://assets.redwood-internal/models/onboarding-arch.png` instead of the S3 link? :+1:
alex: That path is fine. I uploaded a candidate at `gs://redwood-assets-temp/onboarding-arch-v2.png` if you want the v2 image.
ben: happy to review the PR once it's up, ping @ben when ready.
sanjay: quick question: is that filename referenced elsewhere? If other pages link to the old path we should add a redirect or update them too.
linda: I can run a repo grep for the old filename and report back in ~10m :mag:
maria: opened PR: `https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1248` — changes: update image URL to the internal assets host, tweak alt text. CI is running.
maria: also added a redirect line to `_redirects` for the shortlink: `/assets/onboarding-arch.png  /assets/models/onboarding-arch.png  301`
kelly: I can merge after CI passes — please @kelley-ops if you need escalation but looks straightforward. :white_check_mark:
ben: quick review done, left a tiny nit about alt text wording. :eyeglasses:
maria: fixed the nit and pushed a commit. Tests are green.
kelly: Merged PR #1248. :tada: Added a short note to the docs changelog about the rehosted diagram.
linda: grep found two other internal references to the old S3 path — filed follow-up issue #7630 to canonicalize those links.
alex: Awesome, thanks all. Closing out this thread unless anyone needs more from me.
